scripts.upload-api-key: echo $API_KEY | npx wrangler secret put API_KEY
scripts.dev: echo `wrangler dev` not supported with email workers
scripts.test:debug: vitest run --inspect-brk --pool forks --poolOptions.forks.singleFork # To run in a single child process, and will stop on breakpoints when debugged from vscode
scripts.test:debug:no-file-parallelism: vitest run --inspect-brk --no-file-parallelism # If pool is unknown
scripts.test:debug:single-thread: vitest run --inspect-brk --pool threads --poolOptions.threads.singleThread # To run in a single worker
